Title: Validate measurement, mobile performance and test readiness
Scope: Confirm funnel events, revenue attribution, audience/device cohorts, mobile image loading and sample requirements. Investigate LCP before launch.
Acceptance: Verified baseline, event QA, feasibility and predefined sample/stopping rules.

Title: Design and QA the three featured experiments
Scope: Build direct homepage ATC cards, mobile sticky checkout CTA and one-time/subscription purchase toggle. Test cart, variant and subscription behavior.
Acceptance: Staging QA, exposure tracking, accessibility, device coverage and rollback approved.

Title: Homepage direct Add-to-Cart experiment
Scope: Replace Our Story section with shoppable product cards and direct ATC; preserve brand and product information.
Acceptance: 28-day planning window; RPV primary. Check orders, ATC, AOV and device cohorts; extend if sample insufficient.

Title: Mobile sticky checkout experiment
Scope: Keep checkout CTA visible in the mobile cart drawer; run sequentially to reduce funnel interaction with the homepage test.
Acceptance: RPV primary; checkout starts, cart abandonment, orders and usability guardrails.

Title: Purchase options toggle experiment
Scope: Simplify subscription versus one-time purchase choice; analyze mobile and desktop separately.
Acceptance: RPV primary; AOV, ATC, completed orders and subscription accuracy. Do not pool away device-level declines.

Title: Validate mobile and first-time visitor hypotheses
Audit reference and timing: Next steps p25; retest duration assumed
Scope: Retest sticky checkout and purchase-mode simplification, prioritizing mobile and first-time visitors.
Acceptance: Separate eligible cohorts or run sequentially; duration may extend beyond July. No win inferred from simulated slides.

Title: Design and evaluate desktop-specific purchase selector
Scope: Explore a desktop-specific selector and compare with the original rather than copying a modeled mobile winner.
Acceptance: Device-specific hypothesis, sufficient sample and RPV/ATC/AOV/order guardrails before scaling.

Title: Roll out only validated changes and hand over
Scope: Record decisions, release eligible winners gradually, monitor and preserve rollback. Carry inconclusive tests forward.
Acceptance: July is a review checkpoint, not a promise that retests finish or changes ship.

Title: Homepage, PDP and cart clarity improvements
Scope: Taste/natural-ingredient/family hero; lifestyle imagery; PDP close-ups and usage; remove repetition; raise ATC; optional protection toggle.
Acceptance: Approve assets/copy and cart behavior; freeze tested surfaces or isolate cohorts so changes do not contaminate experiments.

Title: Navigation and discovery backlog
Scope: Best Sellers/Gifts/Bundles groups, category thumbnails and flavor/size/occasion filters; evaluate usage showcase and multi-size merchandising.
Acceptance: Prioritized backlog and feasibility; not a blanket commitment to implement all by July.

Title: Cross-sell, personalized hero and checkout progress feasibility
Scope: Assess relevant cross-sells, personalized hero and progress indicators. Verify traffic for multivariate designs, consent for personalization and Shopify checkout constraints.
Acceptance: Commercial/technical go-no-go and separate test briefs; use genuine urgency only. Defer unsupported scope.
